descriptionHtml:
Cougar-EGY DisplayPort to DisplayPort 3M Cable (Male to Male Connection / Gold-Plated Connectors / Supports 4K Resolution at 60Hz Refresh Rate / Supports 2K Resolution at 144Hz Refresh Rate / High-Speed Video Transmission / Durable Shielding / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Experience crystal-clear visual quality and high-refresh-rate performance with the Cougar-EGY DisplayPort to DisplayPort 3M Cable, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Built with corrosion-resistant gold-plated connectors and heavy-duty shielding, this 3-meter male-to-male DP cable seamlessly connects your gaming graphics card to high-resolution monitors, supporting up to 4K resolution at 60Hz and high-speed 2K gaming at 144Hz without signal loss or latency.
